name: Perseus to Andromeda
original_name: ペルセウスとアンドロメダ
source:
Due to the success of the Silver Star Coin play, Satsuki and her class have been asked to do another performance. This time, Satsuki stars with her best friend, and both have to appear on stage completely naked...
